title: [P800] Ascend-aligned selection closure, bounded performance tuning, evidence-matrix convergence

domain_lock.rule: The six domains below are the complete tested surface for issue #9. No shape, semantic, or cell may be added to any domain (to improve averages or to fish a better headline number); the regression domain is the full v5 release domain and may not be narrowed either.

source.frozen_base_note: issue #9 starting point: issue #8 fully closed (v5 snapshot, 14/14 gates, A-3 verify, closing comment). No issue #8 work is redone.

device.card_pool: cards 2,3,4,5,7 healthy idle; card 1 hardware-faulty; cards 0,6 other-tenant
device.contamination_policy: cross-tenant cards, driver/runtime changes, or profile/env drift void the whole round; no manual trial cherry-picking

protocol.timing_scope: api wall time (dispatch+alloc+layout+sync), ms; tiers: plan_creation / steady / one_shot / e2e
protocol.gm_bytes_kind: analytic estimate only; never recorded as measured without hardware counters
protocol.app_proxy_disclosure: non-power-of-2 batches (OFDM B=14/140) run as padded-proxy with the actually executed batch disclosed; never reported as native workload

measurement.interleave: previous/current/incumbent/selector/oracle/vendor interleaved per session with seeded shuffle
measurement.confirmation: candidates frozen before >=3 sessions x 30 steady trials; promotion only by measurement, never by model

budgets.rule: two rounds maximum; per-cell non-vendor legal candidates capped and deduped by descriptor; after two rounds with no stable gain keep the incumbent and submit the negative result instead of widening the search

closure.purpose: confirm existing candidates and deployment closure only; no new kernels in this phase

tune_a.purpose: large-batch core/dataflow optimization (architecture-mapping axis) pressure domain

holdout.purpose: excluded from model calibration and rule changes; confirmation evidence only

regression.purpose: full v5 release domain; re-verify only after the selector is frozen

scale.purpose: clean long-length evidence; every point runs a legality/memory/timeout probe first

apps.purpose: application proxies reported separately; never part of the headline main matrix

OFDM.note: B=14/140 is not a power of two: run as padded-proxy and disclose the executed batch

profile_anchors.purpose: WP3 same-source attribution anchors; re-measured fresh under this config, never spliced from the old phase ledger
record_per_anchor: plan creation / first call / plan-reuse steady API wall / one-shot
requested candidate, resolved plan, actual runner
visible launches, workspace/live set, materialized global boundaries
GM bytes / bandwidth / occupancy as 'analytic estimate' unless counters exist

checks: env_hash and profile_hash match this file
card pool: chosen device is not other-tenant and not the hardware-faulty card

closure.gate: per-cell selector regret <= 10% for every legal deployable cell; every measured runner closed to its deployed runner

profile.gate: every anchor classified into exactly one attribution class with measured vs analytic quantities separated

tune-a.gate: stable gain vs incumbent after >=2% guard on re-measurement, else keep incumbent

tune-p.gate: stable gain vs incumbent after >=2% guard on re-measurement, else keep incumbent

validate.gate: no new stable >2% regressions vs previous; 6 fallbacks and the 3 intentional semantic corrections intact; strict gates green; holdout and scale/app-proxy evidence reported separately from the headline matrix

replay.gate: recorded run reproduces byte-identical analysis into a fresh replay directory

outputs.evidence_policy: raw evidence is immutable; aggregation drift, re-analysis, and replays always write to a new directory (--replay-out)

reporting.headline: main matrix only; app proxies and scale slices never fold into the headline average
